description: The Machine Commerce Observatory: independent readings of x402 and MPP endpoints — alive right now, quoting what, and how fast? Probed on a published schedule under one published rubric, every reading traceable to a retained capture. Blocked and rate-limited are told apart from unreachable at capture time, so a defended endpoint is never reported as dead. Call before paying an unfamiliar endpoint, or to check whether one you use has repriced or rotated its payTo.
